# txt2crs

> An OpenAI-powered education application that turns supported input into a
> researched course, review pack, assessment, and answer key.

## Primary Context

- [Agent instructions](./AGENTS.md): Repository rules and build commands
- [Project overview](./README.md): Product status and quick start
- [Product requirements](./.spec_system/PRD/PRD.md): Completed phased plan and
  current durable requirements
- [Documentation index](./docs/README_docs.md): Engineering and product docs
- [Architecture](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Shell, engine, state, and deployment
  boundaries
- [Folder architecture](./docs/TXT2CRS_FOLDER_ARCHITECTURE.md): Workspace
  dependency rules

## Implementation Areas

- [Backend](./backend/README_backend.md): FastAPI application shell
- [Engine](./backend/packages/txt2crs/README_txt2crs.md): Reusable education
  engine
- [Frontend](./frontend/README_frontend.md): React product shell
- [API](./docs/api/README_api.md): Current HTTP contract

## Operations and Security

- [Configuration](./docs/CONFIGURATION.md): Environment variables

  runbook

## Core Conventions

- Route handlers call the public `txt2crs` package boundary.
- Tests are created before implementation.
- Backend errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details and stable `ErrorCode` values.
- Logs use `{domain}.{action}_{state}` events and trace IDs.
- `frontend/src/client/` is generated and must not be edited manually.
- PostgreSQL stores shell data; tenant-scoped engine jobs use private SQLite
  state under `/var/lib/txt2crs`.

Repository: https://github.com/moshehbenavraham/txt2crs
